ground_truth_diagnosis: Hereditary Angioedema with myoferlin gene mutation (HAE-MYOF)
symptoms_present: Swelling (genital area, tongue, lips, and upper extremities)
Swelling of the face, extremities, and mucosa
symptoms_absent: Normal levels of C1-inhibitor (C1-INH) and C4
final_diagnosis_evidence: Whole-genome sequencing revealed a newly described heterozygous mutation in exon 33 of the MYOF gene, specifically c.2225C > T(p.Ser742Leu).
red_flag_features: Swelling (genital area, tongue, lips, and upper extremities)
discriminating_features: Swelling of the face, extremities, and mucosa
vignette: A 36 years-year-old male presents with Swelling (genital area, tongue, lips, and upper extremities), Hyperesthesia, Marginal erythema, Angioedema of the lips, Abdominal pain, Swelling of the face, extremities, and mucosa.
ollama_review_notes: The presence of angioedema and specific genetic mutation supports the diagnosis. However, some symptoms like abdominal pain could be seen in other conditions.

presenting_complaint: Angioedema of the coccyx, Angioedema involving eyelids, lips, larynx, pharynx, hands, and feet
symptoms_present: Angioedema involving eyelids, lips, larynx, pharynx, hands, and feet
symptoms_absent: Normal levels of C1-inhibitor (C1-INH) and C4
final_diagnosis_evidence: Whole-exome sequencing revealed a heterozygous mutation in the MYOF gene, specifically, in exon 33 at position c.3508 C > T(p.His1170Tyr).
red_flag_features: Angioedema involving eyelids, lips, larynx, pharynx, hands, and feet
vignette: A young adult-year-old female presents with Angioedema of the coccyx, Angioedema involving eyelids, lips, larynx, pharynx, hands, and feet.
